questions.q: For y = x² − 4x − 12, find (a) the roots (b) the y-intercept (c) the turning point, then sketch it
Write 2x² − 12x + 23 in the form a(x − b)² + c and state the turning point.
Use your answer to show that 2x² − 12x + 23 = 0 has no real roots.
questions.a: The minimum value is 5 > 0, so the graph never reaches the x-axis

questions.q: For y = x² + 4x − 5, find the roots, y-intercept and turning point.
questions.model: Roots: (x + 5)(x − 1) = 0, x = −5 or 1. y-intercept: −5. Complete the square: (x + 2)² − 4 − 5 = (x + 2)² − 9, turning point (−2, −9).

questions.q: Find the turning point of y = x² − 2x − 8.
Use the graph of y = x² − 6x + 5 to solve x² − 6x + 5 = −3.
Give the line of symmetry of y = 2x² − 8x + 1.
